title: Stack User Defaults
description: User-global defaults for Claude Code Stack. Lives at ~/.claude/stack-defaults.json. Populated by install.sh, edited by /default-edit global.

additional_directories.description: Paths added to Claude Code's permissions.additionalDirectories

default_domain_mode.description: ADR-053: same oneOf as stack-config-schema.json's domain_mode -- a bare string (single-mode, unchanged) or an array (multi-mode default).

default_required_approvals.description: Default for a fresh project's required_approvals (stack-config-schema.json). Empty array matches today's /project-init output — no gate is unconditionally forced by default, only the MCQ-2 baseline routine denies apply everywhere (scripts/permissions-compile.sh). Lets /project-init's "also become your default for new projects?" prompt (step 4) actually honor a yes answer for this setting, which it could not before (no slot existed to write to).

session_prefs_defaults.description: v1.2: User-level default session preferences. Fallback when a project has no session_prefs and no live session override. Same fields as stack-config session_prefs.

passive_suggest.description: When true, dispatch-nudge.sh appends a pointer to the recommend-capabilities engine.

simple_talk.description: v1.3 (ADR-032): plainness modifier (off/plain/caveman), orthogonal to communication_style. Injected each turn by hooks/simple-talk.sh.

model_fit_receipt.description: v1.3 (ADR-033): post-session model-fit receipt (off/on). on = print one retrospective end-of-session line; off = no receipt, no accrual.

auto_offer_loop.description: ADR-047: when true, hooks/loop-shape-nudge.sh asks (via AskUserQuestion) whether to run a loop-shaped request as a governed loop, once per session. Set false to silence the ask entirely.

auto_offer_advisor_pair.description: ADR-052: when true, hooks/advisor-pair-nudge.sh asks (via AskUserQuestion) to switch to the ladder-recommended advisor pairing whenever the effective model/advisorModel pair changes and no longer matches it. Set false to silence the ask entirely.

guards.description: Rollout-mode defaults for the stack's own gate hooks, keyed by guard name. usage_check_gate (usage-check gate): off = no enforcement, warn = log-only (never blocks), on = blocking. Ships warn -- graduates to on only after real-world validation.

tenant_pack.description: M3 (ADR-034): the tenant pack composed over this install. Written by install.sh --pack after a successful compose.

source.description: Git URL or local path the pack was installed from.

ref.description: Git ref requested at install time, if any.
